stem: Which statement best describes how baby acorn weevils know that it is time to leave their acorn homes?

options.label: A
options.text: They finish eating all the nut meat inside of the acorn.

options.label: B
options.text: An adult acorn weevil drills a new hole in the acorn.

options.label: C
options.text: The acorn drops from the oak tree to the ground below.

options.label: D
options.text: The weather becomes so warm that no acorn shelter is needed.
